name: cavemio-thinking-indicator
title: Thinking indicator
description: Four quiet loaders for the gap before the first token, with a label, a rolling timer and a finish that draws itself.

cavemio.usage:
import { ThinkingIndicator } from "@/components/thinking-indicator";

<ThinkingIndicator variant="orbit" label="Churning" startedAt={sentAt} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- A status region announces the label and then the done message ("Done in 12.4s"); the ticking timer itself is hidden from screen readers.
- The timer re-renders once a second, on the second, and stops when done or unmounted. The mark’s animation is paused once it has faded out.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the marks hold still, nothing sweeps or rolls, and states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: status
props.description: "running" · Animating, or settled with a check.

props.name: label / doneLabel
props.description: "Thinking" · What it says while running, and once done.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: – · Start time in ms; shows the rolling timer and times "Done in".

useCases.title: AI chat apps
useCases.description: The gap between sending a message and the first word of the answer.

useCases.title: Search and research tools
useCases.description: A calm “Searching” state while results are gathered.

useCases.title: Agent tools

useCases.title: Generation tools

features.title: Four marks to choose from
features.description: An orbit, dots, a pulse or a scan.

features.title: A label with a sweep
features.description: A sweep of light crosses the label while it runs.

features.title: A timer that rolls
features.description: The seconds roll up as they pass (“Churning 44s”), and minutes open at one minute.

features.title: Done without a swap
features.description: The mark blurs into a check that draws itself, and the label morphs to “Done in 44.6s”.

features.title: Your own words
features.description: Set the label while running, and a doneLabel for the end.

features.title: Quiet for screen readers
features.description: The label and the done message are announced. The ticking timer is hidden.

states.title: running
states.description: The mark animates, a 1.4s sweep of light crosses the label and the seconds roll up once a second. At a minute, the minutes slide open ("1m 05s").

states.title: done
states.description: The mark shrinks away through a blur and pauses; a check draws itself (420ms); the label morphs to "Done in" and the tenths slide open: "Done in 12.4s". A doneLabel replaces the whole line, and the timer folds away.
